note: Names for the game's planet effects. The game sends each effect as a bare number and its name lives only in the install, so these are read off the game's own map: the curator's screenshots of 12 October 2026, matched to the live status of the same day, where a planet carried exactly one effect of the kind the planet card shows (type 71) or every planet carrying a number showed the same line. A number not listed here is shown as unnamed. npm run effects lists every live number, its planets, and whether it is named. draw is how the map shows it: blackhole and fractured replace the planet, cloud lays a soft zone over every planet carrying it, and none is a name on the card only. gone means nobody drops there any more. A name or say written here is the game's own words.
